// A shared helper an ops screen imported. It is not under an ops root, and the
// transitive local import walk scans it anyway. This is the one-hop laundering
// route the gate exists to close.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function itemsForClass(classId) {
  return db.journalItem.findMany({ where: { classId } });
}
